summary: O Yahweh our Lord how excellent is your name in all earth, who has set glory above heavens, out of mouth of babes you established strength, when I consider heavens work of fingers moon stars which you ordained, what is man that you are mindful of him and son of man that you visit him? For you have made him a little lower than God and crowned him with glory and honor, you make him have dominion over works of hands, put all under feet, all sheep oxen beasts field birds fish, O Yahweh our Lord how excellent is your name in all earth.
whyItMatters: Most quoted anthropology psalm — what is man? Little lower than God/Elohim, crowned with glory honor, dominion, quoted Hebrews 2 about Jesus.

questions.question: What does 'what is man that you are mindful of him?' mean?
questions.answer: When consider heavens work of fingers, moon stars you ordained — vast cosmos — what is enosh (frail man) that you remember him, and ben adam (son of man, human) that you visit (paqad — attend, care)? Contrast vast universe with tiny humans yet God mindful. Not self-deprecation but wonder at dignified smallness: small yet crowned. Hebrews 2 applies to Jesus as representative man who fulfills this crowned role.

glossary.def: Hebrew Elohim can be God, gods, angels — LXX translated angels, quoted Hebrews 2:7 little lower than angels.
Royal coronation language — humans given kingly status over creation.
